title: An idea about the earliest expansion
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: Inflation is a proposed period of extremely rapid early expansion. It can explain several large-scale features, but its physical mechanism and details remain under investigation.

misconception: A learner may choose: The increase in prices on Earth
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: What is cosmic inflation in modern cosmology?
